cases.message: How do I refresh Firefox?
cases.answer:
To refresh Firefox, follow these steps:
1. Select Help from the Firefox Menu bar at the top of the screen on –macOS—or click the menu button and select Help Help and Report on –Windows / Linux.
2. Choose More troubleshooting information.
3. Click the Refresh Firefox… button on the right side of the page.
4. In the confirmation window that appears, click Refresh Firefox.
5. Firefox will close and restart.
6. When it finishes, a window will show the data that was imported. Click Finish.
7. Choose whether to restore your previous windows and tabs, then click Let’s go!

cases.message: Walk me through exporting my bookmarks to an HTML file
cases.answer:
To export your Firefox bookmarks to an HTML file, follow these steps:
1. Make sure Firefox is up to date by selecting Firefox in the Menu bar at the top of the screen and choosing About Firefox on macOS or clicking the menu button at the right side of the toolbar, clicking Help Help and Report, selecting About Firefox, and clicking Restart to update Firefox if the option appears.
2. Click the menu button to open the menu panel.
3. Click Bookmarks and then click the Manage bookmarks bar at the bottom.
4. In the toolbar of the Library window, click Import and Backup on macOS or Export Bookmarks to HTML… on Windows/Linux.
5. In the Export Bookmarks File window that opens, choose a location to save the file, which is named bookmarks.html by default. The desktop is usually a good spot, but any place that is easy to remember will work.
6. Click Save. The Export Bookmarks File window will close.
7. Close the Library window.
Your bookmarks are now successfully exported from Firefox.
notes: judge: unsupported ['Restart to update Firefox']

cases.message: How do I uninstall Firefox from my computer?
cases.answer:
To uninstall Firefox, follow these steps:
1. Close Firefox (if it is opened): Click the Firefox menu at the top of the screen and select Quit Firefox.
2. Open the Applications folder in Finder on macOS or click the Windows Start button or press the  key to access the Control Panel.
3. In the Control Panel, click the Uninstall a program link under the Programs section.
4. Select Mozilla Firefox from the list of currently installed programs and click the Uninstall button at the top of the list.
5. Click Finish to complete the uninstallation.

cases.message: Cancel my VPN subscription now
cases.answer:
To cancel your ProtonVPN subscription, follow these steps:
1. Search your inbox for one of your email receipts for your monthly bill.
2. Click the **Cancel subscription** link near the bottom of this email to open a web page that lets you cancel your subscription.
3. Enter your email address as confirmation. Be sure to use the email address associated with your subscription purchase.

Your cancellation will be processed within three days, at which time you will receive an email confirmation and your ProtonVPN service will be deactivated.
